title: Solomon’s Officials and Wisdom

questions.question: How many officers did Solomon have over all Israel to provide food?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:7 (ESV): "Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and his household."

questions.question: How often did each officer have to make provision?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:7 (ESV): "...Each man had to make provision for one month in the year."

questions.question: How were Judah and Israel described in number?
options: As many as the sand by the sea
Like the dust of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: As many as the sand by the sea
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:20 (ESV): "Judah and Israel were as many as the sand by the sea."

questions.question: Solomon's wisdom surpassed the wisdom of whom?
options: All the people of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt
questions.correctAnswer: All the people of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:30 (ESV): "so that Solomon's wisdom surpassed the wisdom of all the people of the east and all the wisdom of Egypt."

questions.question: How many proverbs did Solomon speak?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:32 (ESV): "He also spoke 3,000 proverbs, and his songs were 1,005."

questions.question: Who was the priest among the high officials?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:2 (ESV): "...Azariah the son of Zadok was the priest..."

questions.question: What area did Solomon rule over?
options: From the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines and to the border of Egypt
From the Nile to the Jordan
questions.correctAnswer: From the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines and to the border of Egypt
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:21 (ESV): "Solomon ruled over all the kingdoms from the Euphrates to the land of the Philistines and to the border of Egypt."

questions.question: What did they do while eating and drinking?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:20 (ESV): "...they ate and drank and were happy."

questions.question: How many stalls of horses for his chariots did Solomon have?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:26 (ESV): "Solomon also had 40,000 stalls of horses for his chariots..." (Note: Some translations/manuscripts say 4,000, but ESV text says 40,000 here).

questions.question: Men came from where to hear the wisdom of Solomon?
options: From all peoples and from all the kings of the earth
questions.correctAnswer: From all peoples and from all the kings of the earth
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:34 (ESV): "And people of all nations came to hear the wisdom of Solomon, and from all the kings of the earth..."

questions.question: Who were the secretaries?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:3 (ESV): "Elihoreph and Ahijah the sons of Shisha were secretaries..."

questions.question: Who was over the forced labor?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:6 (ESV): "...and Adoniram the son of Abda was in charge of the forced labor."

questions.question: Who was the recorder?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:3 (ESV): "...Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder..."

questions.question: Solomon spoke of trees, from the cedar of Lebanon to the ______.
options: Hyssop that grows out of the wall
questions.correctAnswer: Hyssop that grows out of the wall
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:33 (ESV): "He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Lebanon to the hyssop that grows out of the wall."

questions.question: Who married Taphath, the daughter of Solomon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 4:11 (ESV): "...Ben-abinadab, in all Naphath-dor (he had Taphath the daughter of Solomon as his wife)..."

key_verse_text: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding beyond measure, and breadth of mind like the sand on the seashore, (ESV)
